$comment: CONFIRMED authentication header: Authorization: Bearer <OPENANY_API_KEY>. The header is optional. Browsing, search, and pricing work without a key; only run_api needs it. Merge into ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json or .pi/mcp.json. CLI alternative: pi mcp add openany --url https://mcp.openany.si --bearer-token-env-var OPENANY_API_KEY

openany.description: OpenAny lite server: openany_overview, search_apis, get_api, run_api. One API key, pay per call, no monthly fee. The header is optional until run_api.
